method: Exhaustive grid over the 5-torus of gauge-invariant loop holonomies, with the weight vector held fixed at its verified common value, followed by least-squares refinement and clustering on the torus with complex conjugation folded in.
why_this_space: Every solution carries the same weight vector, so only phases are unknown, and modulo the 9-dimensional orbital-phase gauge the 14 phases leave exactly 5 degrees of freedom. The search space is a compact 5-torus, not the 28-dimensional amplitude space that random multi-start was failing to saturate.
